facts.text: Hantek is the USB oscilloscope class: it loads firmware through USB vendor 0x04b4 product 0x6022 and then talks to vendor 0x04b5 product 0x6022
The samplerate table maps 48, 16, 8, 4 and 1 MS/s and 500, 200 and 100 kS/s
set_samplerate accepts a rate only when it is a key of dictN_SR; otherwise it prints the available rates and leaves the device unchanged
The vertical-division table is {1: 1, 2: 0.5, 5: 0.2, 10: 0.1}; dictN_VDiv reverses it
set_chvdiv accepts a channel value only when it is a key of dictN_VDiv
The default samplerate is 16 MS/s per channel and both channels start at 1 V/div
GetData reads dictDatLen_N[samplerate] bytes and returns two voltage arrays scaled by (raw - 128) / 255 * 10 * ChVDiv
buf_len is data_len // 2 samples per channel and dictDatLen_N maps each samplerate to its data length
get_rate returns the samplerate and get_time returns linspace(0, buf_len - 1, buf_len) / samplerate
get_rates returns 50 kHz, 250 kHz, 500 kHz, 2 MHz, 4 MHz, 8 MHz and 24 MHz
close() resets the USB device and disposes its resources

measures.description: Scalar measurements of the most recent acquisition of both channels
measures.name: acquisition

safe_state.description: acquisition stopped and the USB device released by the native close() (the scope has no output)
